2. **Pine Crossing**: you mentioned it yourself (10:48 AM). The morning receiver sees only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.

The channel also mentions "new stores" and three tracker rows that just say "waiting", but it doesn't name them, so they aren't on the list. I haven't checked the Marrow account files, so there may be more sites outside the channel.
